# spotlight_line (Resource)

A line: the stations a team's tasks move along, in order, and how they move. Import it as `<workspace id>/<team key>/<key>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spotlight_line" "core_delivery" {
  team_id = spotlight_team.core.id
  key     = "delivery"
  name    = "Delivery"
  role    = "delivery"
  runners = ["vpc-internal"]

  repository {
    name  = "acme/api"
    image = "ghcr.io/acme/api-runner:main"
    setup = "npm ci"
  }

  station {
    key       = "backlog"
    name      = "Backlog"
    kind      = "backlog"
    passes_to = ["implementation"]
  }

  station {
    key       = "implementation"
    name      = "Implementation"
    harness   = "claude-code"
    profile   = "careful"
    prompt    = file("${path.module}/prompts/core/delivery/implementation.md")
    check     = "npm test"
    tools     = ["linear.comment"]
    skills    = ["grafana"]
    runners   = ["gpu"]
    passes_to = ["code-review"]
  }

  station {
    key       = "code-review"
    name      = "Code review"
    harness   = "claude-code"
    prompt    = "Review the change."
    passes_to = ["implementation"]
    ends      = true
  }

  station {
    key  = "completed"
    name = "Completed"
    kind = "completed"
  }

  reaction {
    happening = "github.checks.failed"
    from      = "implementation"
    to        = "implementation"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Names the line within its team. It is fixed for the line's life, so changing it replaces the line.
- `name` (String) What the line is called.
- `team_id` (String) The team the line belongs to. Changing it replaces the line.

### Optional

- `reaction` (Block Set) Moves a task when something happens, as when a pull request's checks fail. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--reaction))
- `repository` (Block Set) A repository the line works on. Spotlight keeps them sorted by name, so they are a set. The repositories of a line name at most one `image`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--repository))
- `reviews` (Block, Optional) Which pull requests the line reviews, for a line whose role is `review`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--reviews))
- `role` (String) The role the line plays for its team, as in `delivery` or `review`. A role names one line.
- `runners` (Set of String) Where the line's work runs: the labels of a runner pool or trust, any of which a runner must answer to. A station's own `runners` narrow it further. Anywhere when left out.
- `station` (Block List) A station along the line, in order. A line has at least one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--station))

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Names the resource within its workspace, as in `core/delivery`.
- `id` (String) Issued by Spotlight when the line is created, and never changed.
- `version` (Number) Rises with every change to the line; each write sends it back so a change made since is not overwritten.

<a id="nestedblock--reaction"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reaction`

Required:

- `happening` (String) What happens, named source first, as in `github.checks.failed`.
- `to` (String) The station the task moves to, by key.

Optional:

- `from` (String) The station the task must be at, by key; any station when left out.


<a id="nestedblock--repository"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repository`

Required:

- `name` (String) The repository, named `owner/name`.

Optional:

- `image` (String) The runner image every station of this line runs in, built FROM `ghcr.io/usespotlightai/spotlight-runner`; unset runs on the host's default image.
- `setup` (String) Runs in the checkout as the agent before each run's agent starts, and before a change stack check wherever a layer changes a lockfile. Every repository says it when a station has a `check` and `diffs`.


<a id="nestedblock--reviews"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reviews`

Optional:

- `mention` (String) The handle that asks for a review.
- `skip` (Block, Optional) Pull requests not to review. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--reviews--skip))
- `start` (String) `opened`, to review every pull request as it opens, or `mentioned`, to review one when Spotlight is mentioned on it.

<a id="nestedblock--reviews--skip"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reviews.skip`

Optional:

- `authors` (Set of String) Skip pull requests by these GitHub logins, in lower case, as in `dependabot[bot]`. Spotlight keeps them sorted and each once, so they are a set.
- `drafts` (Boolean) Skip draft pull requests.
- `spotlight` (Boolean) Skip pull requests Spotlight opened.



<a id="nestedblock--station"></a>
### Nested Schema for `station`

Required:

- `key` (String) Names the station within the line.
- `name` (String) What the station is called on the board.

Optional:

- `check` (String) A command that must pass before a task moves on, as in `npm test`.
- `color` (String) A six digit hex colour, as in `#6d78d5`. Spotlight picks one when it is left out.
- `decisions` (Boolean) Whether the station records the agent's decisions for review.
- `description` (String) What the station is for.
- `diffs` (Boolean) Whether the station's runs draft a change stack from their diff.
- `effort` (String) How hard the agent thinks: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max`.
- `ends` (Boolean) Whether a task that reaches the station is finished.
- `harness` (String) The agent harness that works tasks here, as in `claude-code`.
- `kind` (String) `backlog`, `work` or `completed`.
- `model` (String) The model the harness uses.
- `passes_to` (Set of String) The stations a task here may move on to, by key.
- `profile` (String) The harness profile the station's agent runs with, by key, as in `careful`.
- `prompt` (String) What the agent is asked to do, usually read with `file()`.
- `runners` (Set of String) Where the station's work runs, beside the line's `runners`: the labels of a runner pool or trust, any of which a runner must answer to.
- `skills` (List of String) The skills the station gives its agent, by key.
- `tools` (List of String) The tools the station gives its agent, as in `linear.comment`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = spotlight_line.core_delivery
  identity = {
    id = "3f8a1c2e-6b4d-4e7a-9c1f-0d2b5e8a7c63"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The id Spotlight issued the line when it was created.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = spotlight_line.core_delivery
  id = "5b1e9d2c-7a43-4f8e-b6c0-3d9a8e1f2b57/core/delivery"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A line is imported by its workspace's id and its address, <team key>/<key>.
terraform import spotlight_line.core_delivery 5b1e9d2c-7a43-4f8e-b6c0-3d9a8e1f2b57/core/delivery
```
